summary: Decoy Therapeutics Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement with an institutional investor for a private placement of common stock and milestone warrants. The company agreed to issue 592,217 shares at $5.91 per share for gross proceeds of approximately $3.5 million, plus pre-funded warrants and Series A/B/C warrants exercisable at $5.91 per share. The transaction is not a special situation but a routine capital raise for general corporate purposes, including advancing a lead asset into clinical trials. No board recommendation, advisors, or change of control aspects are involved. This filing does not represent a merger, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or any other special-situation event; it is an ordinary equity financing under Item 1.01, and thus classified as None.
